Today, when the topic of Canadian Cannabis comes up, we think of Canada’s legal cannabis industry.

SeeMost Canadians Still Regard Marijuana Legalization Favourabl

However, I have been writing about how otherwise respectable publications have been publishing “the latest research” about how marijuana is so much stronger (and therefore dangerous) than it used to be way back when we all thought it was harmless.

See National Geographic Demonstrates the Failure of Even The Most Respected Publications To Report Accurately On Marijuana Prohibition.

And Why Does Newsweek Push Prohibitionist Propaganda?

AlsoThe Perils of Potent Pot Party Line: Blaming Marijuana Legalization for Increase in THC Levels


But 25 years ago, it was something else entirely. The Prohibitionist Party Line decided to make British Columbia, Canada’s western most province, the new Colombia, South America’s evil source of the evil weed. Suddenly, ordinary indoor weed became BC Bud!!!

From the archives:USA Today Recycles A July Story About BC Marijuana Being Traded Pound For Pound For Coke; It Was Prohibitionist Non-Sense Then, And It Still Is.

Yes, pound for pound for coke!!!

And Time Magazine Is Improving On The Party Line On "B. C. Bud." Now it averages 30% THC! That is really B. S. Bud!


And now it gets really weird Time Magazine Reports BC Bud 20% Less Potent Than Four Years Ago??  Incompetent Prohibitionist Propaganda and Even Worse Journalism. As Some Reporters Die to Find the Truth Others Live to Lie.

Yes, four years after Time said that BC Bud was 30%, now it was up to 20%.??? Or something like that.

So, the next time you see an article or editorial about the new potent pot menace, tell them that you read in Time Magazine that it used to be 30% THC.

And then tell them that it must be a lot safer now than back in the olden days when everyone thought it was dangerous.

There are other articles in the archives about BC Bud.

Someone might even say that the Best Two Word Explanation for Marijuana Prohibition is Bad Journalism.
